title: White Chocolate Bread Pudding with Warm White Chocolate Sauce
summary: A rich, custardy bread pudding made with white chocolate, baked until golden and puffed and served with a warm white chocolate sauce.

ingredients.item: day-old French bread, cut into 2.5 cm cubes

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Spread 255 g bread cubes on a tray and toast at 180 °C until dry but barely coloured, 8-10 min, then tip into a buttered tin.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Warm 360 ml milk, 120 ml cream and 65 g sugar until steaming, then off the heat whisk in 170 g white chocolate until smooth.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Beat 4 egg yolks, 1 egg and ½ tsp vanilla, then slowly whisk in the warm chocolate mixture.

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Pour the custard over the bread, pressing down so all the cubes are soaked, and leave to stand 20-30 min.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 180 °C until puffed, golden and just set with a centre temperature of 71 °C, 35-40 min.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Simmer 120 ml cream, take off the heat, whisk in 55 g white chocolate until smooth.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Cool the pudding 10 min, then serve warm with the sauce poured over.

tips: Toast the bread cubes lightly first so they soak up the custard without turning soggy.
Press the bread down into the custard a few times while it soaks so every cube is coated.
safety: Check the centre reaches 71 °C so the custard is fully set before taking the pudding out of the oven.
storage: Best served warm on the day of baking; keep covered in the fridge and reheat gently if there are leftovers.
